Hi Alyssa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — great conversation. We talked about getting Northshore enrolled in the AWS ACE co-sell program so we can pursue GTM funding and close the procurement items faster. I want to kick off a short alignment thread for the ACE registration + PDM/PSM intros so we can agree next steps.

Proposed next steps:
- We (Redwood) submit ACE enrollment and share the checklist with Northshore (1–2 business days).
- AWS PDM/PSM intro call (30 min) to align on co-sell motion and expected deliverables.
- Identify procurement artifacts Northshore needs for contract review (SOW, data handling, SOC 2 evidence).

Can you confirm the right procurement contact (cc'd or alternate), and whether Northshore has a preferred timeline for the enrollment? I attached a draft SOW and our ACE checklist for reference.

Thanks — I’ll coordinate with our PDM/PSM folks once we have the procurement lead.

Hi Naomi — thanks for the note and the materials. I’m the product lead; Dante (cc) is procurement and will handle SOW/redline questions. A couple quick items from our side:

- Timeline: procurement needs two weeks to review SOW and security artifacts; ideal go/no-go for enrollment would be 10/25.
- Security: can you share SOC 2 report and evidence around customer data isolation?
- Pricing: high-level TCV and preferred term lengths would help procurement size the ask for AWS funding.

Alyssa / Dante —

Appreciate the timeline. Quick responses to your asks below:

- SOC 2: Kimberly is attaching the SOC 2 summary and a redacted report snapshot. Full SOC package can be provided under NDA; Kimberly can drop to a secure link.
- Data isolation: Redwood’s Private deployments and Dedicated pool options allow customer-dedicated capacity; we’ll include a short architecture diagram in the secured packet.
- Pricing: high-level TCV scenarios are below (estimates for sizing AWS co-sell):
  * Pilot (3 months): $18k — proof-of-concept on dedicated node (limited tokens)
  * Initial production (12 months): $210k — baseline throughput, reserved capacity
  * Scale plan (12 months + autoscale): $420k — aggressive SLAs and reserved burst capacity

Ben will own SOW redlines and work with your procurement. Ben — can you take lead here and push an updated SOW by EOD 10/08?

Next: I’ll open the ACE registration form with AWS and cc the PDM/PSM for an intro. Proposed meeting window for PDM/PSM intro: 10/12 or 10/13 PST (30 min). Does that work for everyone?

Best,
Naomi
